articles.title: 'Go to Pakistan': Dipke on those doing Hindu-Muslim 'divisive' politics
articles.summary: Abhijeet Dipke led a large protest in Mumbai demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. Thousands of supporters gathered at Shivaji Park, despite police denying permission for the event.

articles.title: Security lapse Israel overlooked? Over 12 Omani pilots flew to Tel Aviv despite ban
articles.summary: Israeli passengers, the captain and other pilots on board intervened, allowing the plane to make an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia. Most of the passengers were Israeli and were later flown from Saudi Arabia to Israel.

articles.title: Watch: Hindu temple in US attacked with bricks, windows shattered
articles.summary: An attack on the Shree Swaminarayan Vadtal Dham Hindu Mandir in Richmond Heights occurred while devotees were present. The incident involved bricks being thrown at the temple, resulting in shattered windows.

articles.title: China tells families of AI executives to get permission before travelling abroad
articles.summary: China is implementing expanded travel restrictions on senior professionals in the AI and semiconductor sectors. Family members, including spouses and children, may now require government approval for overseas travel.

articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: Sonali Kulkarni celebrates ‘The Paradise’ success as Nani’s film crosses Rs 100 crore in India
articles.summary: Nani and Srikanth Odela's action thriller 'The Paradise' has reached a remarkable milestone, grossing Rs 100 crore in India. To celebrate, actress Sonali Kulkarni cut a cake, expressing her gratitude to the audience.

articles.title: Arjun Das talks Don 3: Actor says villain role is off
articles.summary: Arjun Das has confirmed that Farhan Akhtar approached him for 'Don 3', saying they met and discussed the film, but it isn't happening now. He hopes to work with Farhan soon and has a Hindi film in post-production.

articles.title: Oscar buzz grows for ‘Godzilla’ ahead of ‘Ramayana’ clash
articles.summary: Takashi Yamazaki's film 'Godzilla Minus Zero' has received strong praise and a high Rotten Tomatoes score. It follows the award-winning 'Godzilla Minus One' which won an Oscar for Best Visual Effects.

articles.title: Fahadh Faasil reveals why he stared wide-eyed
articles.summary: In a light-hearted reflection, Fahadh Faasil recounted the amusing viral moment from an event where a girl perfectly imitated him, catching him off guard. His surprised expression quickly became meme material, much to his delight.
